modules.title: Foundational Skills for Tech Careers
modules.description: Strengthen logical reasoning and mathematical foundations to build problem-solving capabilities.

sub_modules.title: Logical Reasoning Fundamentals

activities.title: Logical Reasoning Basics Quiz

activities.title: Interactive Logic Puzzles
activities.description: Engage with visual and text-based puzzles to reinforce logical thinking.

learning_outcomes: Understand propositional logic and deductive reasoning
Apply logical frameworks to solve algorithmic problems

sub_modules.title: Math for Tech Professionals
sub_modules.description: Develop mathematical proficiency relevant to software development and data analysis.

activities.title: Math Essentials Diagnostic
activities.description: Identify gaps in arithmetic, algebra, and basic statistics knowledge.

activities.title: Math Problem Workshops
activities.description: Practice solving real-world tech problems using mathematical models.

learning_outcomes: Perform calculations required for coding and data analysis
Apply mathematical principles to algorithm design

modules.title: Motivation & Mindset Development
modules.description: Build sustainable motivation through goal-setting and cognitive behavioral techniques.

sub_modules.title: Motivation Foundations
sub_modules.description: Explore psychological principles behind sustained tech career motivation.

activities.title: Motivation Self-Assessment
activities.description: Identify personal drivers and common motivational barriers.

activities.title: Goal-Setting Workshops
activities.description: Practice SMART goal creation for career and project milestones.

learning_outcomes: Understand intrinsic vs extrinsic motivation factors

sub_modules.title: Overcoming Procrastination
sub_modules.description: Implement time management techniques to maintain motivation.

activities.title: Procrastination Audit
activities.description: Track patterns and identify root causes of delayed tasks.

activities.title: Pomodoro Challenge
activities.description: Practice focused work sessions with built-in breaks.

learning_outcomes: Develop strategies to combat task avoidance

modules.title: Time Management Mastery
modules.description: Optimize productivity through prioritization and scheduling techniques.

sub_modules.title: Prioritization Frameworks
sub_modules.description: Learn methods to focus on high-impact tasks.

activities.title: Eisenhower Matrix Exercise

learning_outcomes: Differentiate between urgent and important tasks

sub_modules.title: Productivity Tools

activities.description: Evaluate and choose productivity software based on needs.

activities.title: Workflow Automation Practice
activities.description: Automate repetitive tasks using available tools.

modules.title: Integration & Application
modules.description: Combine skills through real-world project implementation.

sub_modules.title: Career Development Project
sub_modules.description: Apply learned skills to a comprehensive career planning task.
learning_outcomes: Create a holistic career development plan
